statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 is an advisory against the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package (unmaintained, unsafe by design; no fixed version). Trivy matches it at module level because nats-server v2.15.0 depends on golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0. The nats-server binaries Sentinel ships (x86_64 and aarch64, pinned by sha256 in deploy/tools.lock) do not link that package: their function tables contain no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp symbol, while symbols of the x/crypto packages nats-server does use (bcrypt, ocsp, chacha20poly1305) are present. Sentinel never processes OpenPGP data. Re-verified on every scan (supplychain.evidence).
